records.text: On 30 October 2023 the Council adopted United Kingdom draft S/2023/808 by 15 votes to none as resolution 2704 (2023). [VOTE]

OPERATIVE.text: On 30 October 2023 the Council adopted United Kingdom draft S/2023/808 by 15 votes to none as resolution 2704 (2023). [VOTE] It extended the UN Verification Mission in Colombia to 31 October 2024 and expressed willingness to work with Colombia's Government on further extension based on agreement between the parties. [OPERATIVE]

ADDITIONAL.text: On 30 October 2023 the Council adopted United Kingdom draft S/2023/808 by 15 votes to none as resolution 2704 (2023). [VOTE] Resolution 2694 already authorized Government–ELN monitoring and verification. Resolution 2704 expressed willingness to consider Government–EMC verification if the Secretary-General confirms a ceasefire with appropriate protocols, taking into account his update on implementation of resolution 2694. [ADDITIONAL]

BRAZIL.text: On 30 October 2023 the Council adopted United Kingdom draft S/2023/808 by 15 votes to none as resolution 2704 (2023). [VOTE] Speaking nationally after presiding, Brazil grounded Council support in priorities expressed by Colombia's Government and hoped for later EMC authorization once sufficiently mature. [BRAZIL]

A3.text: On 30 October 2023 the Council adopted United Kingdom draft S/2023/808 by 15 votes to none as resolution 2704 (2023). [VOTE] Ghana, for the A3, supported prospective EMC verification subject to the Secretary-General's conditions and committed to encouraging Ethnic Chapter progress for Afro-Colombian and Indigenous people. [A3]
